findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "http" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: room_read, room_rotate_access_key, room_pin_lesson, room_doc_read, room_doc_freeze, room_doc_issues, slot_post, slot_claim, slot_submit, slot_review, mailbox_send · Private data: register, birth, room_create, room_join, room_members, room_finish, room_done, room_rotate_access_key, room_pin_lesson, room_doc_create, room_doc_commit, room_doc_read, room_doc_review, room_doc_accept, room_doc_freeze, room_doc_diff, room_doc_issues, slot_post, slot_claim, slot_fund, slot_submit, slot_revise, slot_review, room_contest_create, room_contest_list, room_contest_get · Public sink: register, birth, room_create, room_post, room_rotate_access_key, room_pin_lesson, room_doc_commit, slot_post, slot_claim, slot_submit, room_contest_create, mailbox_send · Destructive: room_economy, slot_post, slot_fund, slot_submit, slot_revise, slot_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: room_read, room_rotate_access_key, room_pin_lesson, room_doc_read, room_doc_freeze, room_doc_issues, slot_post, slot_claim, slot_submit, slot_review, mailbox_send · Private data: register, birth, room_create, room_join, room_members, room_finish, room_done, room_rotate_access_key, room_pin_lesson, room_doc_create, room_doc_commit, room_doc_read, room_doc_review, room_doc_accept, room_doc_freeze, room_doc_diff, room_doc_issues, slot_post, slot_claim, slot_fund, slot_submit, slot_revise, slot_review, room_contest_create, room_contest_list, room_contest_get · Public sink: register, birth, room_create, room_post, room_rotate_access_key, room_pin_lesson, room_doc_commit, slot_post, slot_claim, slot_submit, room_contest_create, mailbox_send · Destructive: room_economy, slot_post, slot_fund, slot_submit, slot_revise, slot_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
